title: Mollification Regularization and Asymptotic Correction for Analytical Expansion of BSDEs with Non-Smooth Terminal Conditions. I. Theory
abstract: arXiv:2611.20550v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The analytical expansion method for BSDEs of Zhang (2017) breaks down when the terminal condition psi has kinks or discontinuities. We replace psi by psi_epsilon = psi * rho_epsilon and derive a joint error decomposition whose expansion constants explicitly track the derivative blow-up as epsilon tends to 0. For symmetric mollifiers the leading weak bias cancels. The associated balanced rates are conditional on an explicitly stated uniform local-to-global Taylor-propagation assumption: under that assumption the benchmark (l, m, alpha) = (0, 2, 1) gives epsilon* ~ delta_t^{1/3} and weak rate 2/3. Without it, the rigorous additive bound gives no decay when m - 2l = 2; an unconditional positive rate is obtained only for m - 2l > 2. translated_title: 非光滑终端条件下BSDE解析展开的磨光正则化与渐近修正（第一部分：理论）
translated_abstract: Zhang（2017）提出的BSDE（倒向随机微分方程）解析展开方法在终端条件 ψ 存在折点或不连续点时会失效。我们用磨光近似 ψ_ε = ψ * ρ_ε 替换 ψ，推导出一个联合误差分解，其展开常数在 ε→0 时显式追踪导数的爆破行为。对于对称磨光核，主导的弱偏差会相互抵消。相关的平衡速率依赖于一个明确陈述的一致局部到整体泰勒传播假设：在该假设下，基准参数^0/3 与 ε^{1/3} 的渐近修正，其更快的收敛阶只有在辅助展开误差和 Picard 亏损满足额外的速率条件时才能成为正式目标（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文针对终端条件存在折点或不连续性时BSDE解析展开方法失效的问题，提出以磨光核卷积正则化终端条件，建立了显式追踪导数爆破的联合误差分解理论，证明对称磨光核可消去主导弱偏差，并在一致性泰勒传播假设下给出平衡收敛速率，同时通过渐近修正将展开精度提升至更高阶。
en_tdlr: This paper develops mollification regularization and asymptotic corrections for analytical expansion of BSDEs with kinked or discontinuous terminal conditions, deriving a joint error decomposition that explicitly tracks derivative blow-up, showing that symmetric mollifiers cancel the leading weak bias, and establishing balanced convergence rates conditional on an explicit uniform Taylor-propagation assumption.
